question: How do I register for classes?
answer: Students can register for classes through PantherTracks by logging into PVPlace and accessing the registration section. PantherTracks allows students to add, drop, and manage their courses. Registration dates may vary each semester. To access the system, visit: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: What are the steps to register for classes?
answer: Students typically register for classes by logging into PVPlace, opening PantherTracks, selecting the correct term, and adding courses through the registration section. Course availability may vary by term and classification. Visit: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: Where can I see my class schedule?
answer: Students can view their class schedule in PantherTracks after logging into PVPlace. The system allows students to see enrolled courses, class times, and locations. Schedule availability may depend on registration status. Access it here: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: How do I print my class schedule?
answer: Students can usually print or save their class schedule after viewing it in PantherTracks. Printing options may depend on the browser or device being used. Access PantherTracks here: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: How do I drop a class?
answer: Students can drop a class through PantherTracks by accessing the registration section and selecting the option to drop courses. Deadlines may apply, and dropping a class could affect academic standing or financial aid. For access, visit: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: How do I add a class?
answer: Students can add classes through PantherTracks during the registration or add/drop period. Class availability may depend on seat openings, restrictions, and deadlines. Access the system here: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: When does registration open?
answer: Registration dates at PVAMU vary depending on the semester and student classification. Students should check the academic calendar or PantherTracks for exact registration periods. For updates, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/registrar/academic-calendars/

question: Who can help me with class registration?
answer: Students can receive help with class registration from their academic advisor or the registrar’s office. Advisors assist with course planning and degree requirements, while the registrar handles registration processes. For more information, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/registrar/

question: Does PVAMU have a class waitlist?
answer: Waitlist availability depends on the course and registration system settings for a given term. Students should check PantherTracks or contact their academic advisor for the most accurate information. Visit: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/ and advisor information is available here: https://www.pvamu.edu/student-success/pv-cares/academic-advisors/

question: How do I know if a class is full?
answer: Students can view course availability in PantherTracks during registration. The system may show whether seats are open, closed, or restricted. For access, visit: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/

question: Who do I contact about my degree plan?
answer: Students should contact their academic advisor for help with their degree plan. Advisors assist with course selection, graduation requirements, and academic progress. To find your advisor, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/student-success/pv-cares/academic-advisors/

question: How do I check my degree progress?
answer: Students can review their academic progress using degree evaluation tools in PantherTracks, if available for their program. Academic advisors can also help explain remaining requirements. Access PantherTracks here: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/ and advisor information here: https://www.pvamu.edu/student-success/pv-cares/academic-advisors/

question: How do I change my major?
answer: Students can change their major by contacting their academic advisor and completing the required forms or approval process. Requirements may vary by department. For more information, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/student-success/pv-cares/academic-advisors/

question: How do I add or change a minor?
answer: Students who want to add or change a minor should contact their academic advisor or the department offering the minor. The process may require approval and updated academic planning. Advisor information is available here: https://www.pvamu.edu/student-success/pv-cares/academic-advisors/

question: How do I know if a class is online or in person?

answer: Students may be able to withdraw from a class by following the official withdrawal process through PantherTracks or the Registrar’s Office. Withdrawal deadlines may affect academic standing or financial aid. For more information, visit: https://www.pvamu.edu/registrar/

question: What is the attendance policy for classes?

Instructors may include attendance as part of the course grade or participation requirements. Students should contact their instructor for course-specific policies and check Canvas or PVPlace for course materials: https://pvplace.pvamu.edu/
